newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian unions oppose Hoogovens/Boel deal.
newsitem.headline: Belgian unions oppose Hoogovens/Boel deal.

text.p: Belgian unions oppose a partnership announced on Tuesday between Dutch metals group Koninklijke Hoogovens and steelmaker Usines Gustave Boel of Belgium, the socialist union FGTB's Roger Leclerq said.
"We fear that this accord weakens and harms Boel," spokesman Leclerq said. He said members of the Christian union CSC had already blocked truck access to a Boel steel plant on Tuesday.
Leclerq said the accord involved the closing of Boel's heavy steel section at its La Louviere, Belgium, plant and the loss of 700 of 1,800 jobs. He warned of further action in coming days.

Loss-making Boel said on Tuesday that cooperating with a major steel player such as Hoogovens would create opportunities through a restructuring. The cooperation would take the form of a 50/50 partnership for the recapitalization of Boel.
Hoogovens and Boel said the transaction would be completed by the end of the year after further investigation and a due diligence procedure.
